rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0001
rows.name:
So you're the brave warriors
trying to stop Heaven's Holy
Grail's outrageous acts?

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0002
rows.name: I am a bard of battle...

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I turn the path of brave warriors'
battles into song and pass it down to
future generations.

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Would you tell me about the path of
your battles so far?

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0201
rows.name:
Hardship and conflict... connections
with many people... and bonds between
humans and Blades...

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0202
rows.name:
Every one of them was a wonderful
story that resonated with my heart.

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0203
rows.name:
Thanks to you, I want to know even
more about the path of your battles.

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0204
rows.name:
Please come tell me more stories
again.

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0301
rows.name:
Oh, truly? That is regrettable,
to say the least.

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0302
rows.name:
I thought I could hear wonderful
stories from you that would resonate
in many people's hearts, but...

rows.label: tlk70000158_01_msg0303
rows.name:
I'm always here. If you change your
mind, please come tell me your
stories.
